frozen_method.account_effect: Non-economic proposal and structural screen only; no economic outcome is authorized.
frozen_method.event_rule: At close of bar t, high-low range >= 2 * median(high-low) over bars t-20 through t-1.
frozen_method.independence: Use at most one event per symbol per UTC date, the first qualifying event with complete baseline and forward windows; exclude conflicting, missing, or non-contiguous windows.
frozen_method.inference: Split eligible UTC dates chronologically into two halves; require at least 10 eligible dates in each half, test the paired daily log variance ratios for positive median separately in both halves, and apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 0.05 across the fixed 41-symbol family using the larger half p-value per symbol. Fail closed on insufficient data.
frozen_method.input: Already accepted 13-week M5 captures only; use strictly prior completed bars to identify events.
frozen_method.outcome: Compare realized variance from the next six completed M5 returns with realized variance from the six completed returns immediately before bar t; direction is ignored.
prohibitions: Do not use prior structural outcomes to alter thresholds, horizons, splits, or the panel.
Do not rerun or relabel prior directional breakout diagnostics.
Do not select a winning subgroup or claim economic equivalence, economic promotion, or family closure.

decision.hypothesis: A completed M5 bar whose high-low range is at least twice the median range of the preceding 20 completed bars is followed by higher unsigned 30-minute realized volatility than the six-bar pre-event baseline.
decision.implementation_scope: Implement a new deterministic non-economic evaluator and focused tests for causal event construction, UTC-date event deduplication, chronological splitting, missing/non-contiguous windows, multiplicity, and fail-closed data sufficiency. Bind inputs to the accepted 13-week M5 captures and process the full current representative panel exactly once. Make no broker/provider calls and do not open an economic experiment.

scope.breadth_reason: Use the full current structural-representative panel to preserve non-economic structural heterogeneity and avoid outcome-driven subgroup selection. Representatives are not economic equivalents.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Create the new frozen evaluator, tests, and hash-bound non-economic result described in decision.frozen_method. Existing directional breakout evaluators are not substitutes for this unsigned-volatility estimand.

objective.goal: Test whether unusually large M5 range shocks predict elevated subsequent unsigned realized volatility.
objective.information_gain_rationale: This addresses volatility clustering rather than signed directional follow-through or persistence. It is a distinct, prospectively specified question on the current 41 structural representatives; it does not retune the prior breakout diagnostics or use their outcomes to choose parameters.
